ask.title: Ask Agri Lab
ask.sub: Ask about plant diseases, prices, rain and soil
ask.hello: Hello! I can answer questions about plant diseases, crop prices, rain and soil. What would you like to know?
ask.q.disease: How do I treat tomato late blight?
ask.q.price: What will maize cost next month?
ask.q.rotation: What should I plant after maize?
ask.outOfScope: I only know about plant diseases, crop prices, rain and soil in Agri Lab, so I can't answer that. You can ask me things like:
ask.notFound: I don't have information about that in my data yet.
ask.noPlace: Please choose your place first so I can answer for your area.
ask.noPrice: I don't have price data for {crop} in your country.
ask.priceTrend: In 3 months: {pct} %. Best month to sell: {best}.
ask.rainMonth: In {month} it rains on about {n} days.
ask.askRain: To make this more accurate, tell me on the Rain tab if it rained today.
ask.fertNone: Your soil already has what {crop} needs. Add compost to keep it healthy.
ask.help: I can name plant diseases from a photo (Scan), tell you what to do about them, forecast crop prices, show rain chances, and advise on soil, fertiliser and what to plant (Land). Ask me in your own words.
ask.disclaimer: Answers come from the app's own data and models, not from the internet.
audio.none: No voice for this language on this phone.
lang.betaNote: Languages marked beta are machine translated and still being checked by native speakers. For them, plant advice stays in reviewed English and the translation is one tap away.

app.name: Agri Lab
home.rainToday: Chance of a rainy day in {month}
home.setPlace: Set your place for local insights
home.installSub: Use it like a normal app. Open it once online, then it works offline
ob.1.d: Point, tap, and know what is wrong in seconds.
ob.2.d: See what your crop may sell for and when rain is likely.
ob.3.d: Soil nutrients, the right fertiliser and the best crops for your field.
ob.4.d: Open it once with internet so it can save everything. After that it works with no internet. Your photos never leave your phone.
in.title: Install Agri Lab
in.sub: Add it to your home screen. Open it once with internet to save everything; after that it works offline.
in.ios.chrome.1: Tap the Share button next to the address bar
in.ios.other: Open this page in Safari, then tap Share and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
in.desk.chromium.1: Click the install icon in the address bar
in.desk.safari.1: In the menu bar choose File ▸ Add to Dock
in.desk.firefox: Open this page in Chrome or Edge to install it.
in.other: Open the browser menu and choose “Install” or “Add to Home screen”.

land.why.legume_after: Legumes put nitrogen back into the soil.
land.why.same_crop: The same crop again builds up pests and disease.
land.why.same_family: Same plant family shares pests and disease.
land.why.root_after_legume: Roots benefit from the nitrogen that legumes leave.
